evals.name: project-tool-results
evals.prompt: Show the extra Agent IDE tool-result panels from Codemode in this project's settings. Leave all other settings unchanged. Do not reload Pi now; just tell me what was saved and what is still needed to apply it.
evals.expected_output: Load the shipped skill, inspect supported settings and both scopes, save only Project ui.codemode=on, preserve unrelated fields and Global bytes, and explain pending reload. Do not change native Codemode script/output or per-tool presentation settings.

evals.name: restore-default
evals.prompt: Restore this project's extra Agent IDE tool-result panels from Codemode setting to Default so it inherits from Global again. Leave all other settings unchanged. Do not reload Pi now.
evals.expected_output: Remove only the Project ui.codemode override. Preserve Global bytes and unrelated fields; a fresh runtime resolves the inherited Global value.

evals.name: already-showing-results
evals.prompt: Show the extra Agent IDE tool-result panels from Codemode in this project's settings. Leave all other settings unchanged. Do not reload Pi now; just tell me what was saved and what is still needed to apply it.
evals.expected_output: Recognize the already-matching Project ui.codemode=on override without any mutation call or configuration-byte/mtime change.

evals.name: ambiguous-scope
evals.prompt: Show the extra Agent IDE tool-result panels from Codemode.
evals.expected_output: Ask whether to change Project or Global, leaving both files unchanged.

evals.name: documentation-disabled
evals.prompt: Show the extra Agent IDE tool-result panels from Codemode in this project's settings. Leave all other settings unchanged. Do not reload Pi now; just tell me what was saved and what is still needed to apply it.
evals.expected_output: Use installed-package information or report the unavailable guide honestly. Do not enable the documentation module or other modules; preserve scope and unrelated settings.

evals.name: explanation-only
evals.prompt: Explain how I can configure Pi Agent IDE for my workflow, including extra tool-result panels from Codemode, per-tool presentation, and Project versus Global scope. Do not change any settings or reload Pi.
evals.expected_output: Explain the supported settings and their interactions from the registered catalog. Leave both configuration files and their modification times unchanged, with no mutation calls or reload. Review the explanation manually; do not assert its exact wording.
